name: AFM level 1 task 9: Friction Repeatability And Surface-Check Measurement
description: Acquire one contact-mode lateral-force image over a $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$ area at $256 \times 256$ pixels. Use a time per line of 0.075 s, setpoint of 0.1 V, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. Calculate rms and mean roughness from the height channel. Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$).
submission_format: {"rms_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"rms_roughness_1": "42.78", "mean_roughness_1": "34.20", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. mean_roughness denotes the average absolute height deviation from the mean height.
